gradingNotes: The directive sits under story 078's own Implementation-Notes/constraints section and is scoped to story 078's OWN change (view-key collapse onto ViewRouter). It reads as 'do not modify DeployMocks.s.sol *as part of this story*', not as a standing repo-wide prohibition.

The HEAD delta touches ZERO of the view surfaces story 078 was protecting — no DepositPageView / DepositPageViewV3 / MintPageView / ViewRouter / DROPPED_CONTRACT_NAMES line is changed by the +293/-1 diff. The +293 lines are confined to the Kendu toggle, Phase 7.6, and the terminal sweep.
Consequently the tension appears to be nominal rather than substantive, but it is a real cross-story directive conflict and is left for script-auditor to grade rather than dismissed here.

observations.text: The in-source claim 'The hook is REUSED, not redeployed, and no new phUSD.setMinter grant is issued' (:1762-1764) is VERIFIED. Phase 7.6 calls _wireUniboost (setMinter(nftMinterV2) + setAuthorizedPooler(multiPooler)), NOT _deployUniboostHook (which is what constructs a hook and calls phUSD.setMinter). The two helpers are easily confused by name; the correct one is called.

_finalizeUniboost's 2nd (UniboostMintDebtHook) and 4th (address) parameters are UNNAMED and unused in the body. Passing `hook` and `deployer` at :1858 is therefore decorative. Not a defect, but the story-079 Decision 7 framing ('the full recipe, not a subset') rests on setRecipient/setDonationSplit/setNudgeStreamer only.

_accrueIndex1MintDebt drives a real mint whose retained (non-donated) prime USDC — 50% at donationSplit == 50 — stays on the INCUMBENT dispatcher. Phase 7.6 swaps the dispatcher out immediately afterwards and never pool()s or sweeps it, so the local chain deterministically strands that USDC on a retired contract. The mainnet _swapUniboost has no sweep either. Observation only; a mock-token dust residue locally, but it is a mechanic the rehearsal now exercises and does not assert about.

replaceDispatcher also repoints tokenIdToDispatcher[index]. Phase 7.6 asserts configs, dispatcherToIndex (both directions) and the hook pair, but does NOT assert tokenIdToDispatcher — the field NFTMinterV2's tokenURI/metadata path reads.
In-source step numbering skips 6 (runs 0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10). Story 079 records this at :719 as the deliberately-skipped live probe (Decision 9) and flags it as reader-confusing. Cosmetic.

`dev` uses a bare `sleep 3` as the only anvil-readiness gate, and `&` backgrounds `clean:local && start:anvil` as a unit so `deploy:local` races anvil startup. Pre-existing, unchanged by this delta; noted because the added Phase 7.6 lengthens the broadcast bundle.
`require(price < 1e12, "index price is not 6-decimal-shaped")` is a magnitude heuristic, not a decimals check. It has no mainnet counterpart.
